items.author: Fedor Shabashev
items.summary: Generative models have become the standard approach in language and vision. These models are typically pretrained first and then fine-tuned. items.title: Optimal Regulation and Information Institutions with Hidden Network Equilibria
items.author: Christian Jaag
items.summary: Aggregate outcomes can conceal network configurations that expose households to uninsurable risk and require different public services. We study a regulator's joint choice of a corrective activity charge and an information institution in a two-population network game. items.title: Tabular Foundation Models in Financial Predictions
items.author: Ed deHaan
items.summary: This technical note introduces tabular foundation models (TFMs) to accounting research and evaluates their performance in one common benchmark task: predicting firms' next-year earnings changes.
